description: Ministry of Education Sports and Youth Affairs - National of Sports Published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1990/23 Dated 27th October 2016 are Amended only in relevance to the Year 2020
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically amending previous regulations regarding the constitution of National Associations/Federations of Sports and selection committees. The content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments to existing sports legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
